SYNTHETIC TEST FIXTURE — NOT PNW POLICY

Synthetic graduation application procedure

Published steps for the 2030-2031 Synthetic Data Science, MS program

  1. Review the published graduation requirements for the applicable catalog.
  2. Ask the academic advisor to review the planned completion term.
  3. Submit the fictional graduation application through the student portal.
  4. Monitor official university messages for any requested follow-up.

Submitting an application does not establish that degree requirements are complete. Only the appropriate university review can determine an individual's graduation status.
